title: Iron Legion formation rules (content/rules/formation.json5)
description: Engine tunables read by the formation systems (Simulation Spec 4 and 15.1). Every field is required in the flagship game because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

keep_slot_radius.description: Metres: a soldier this close to its old slot keeps it on reform (SIM-FORM-022).

integrity_radius.description: In file spacings (sf): distance to the slot that still counts as in formation (SIM-FORM-030).

integrity_morale_threshold.description: Integrity below which the morale factor applies (SIM-FORM-031).

morph_speed_mult.description: Regiment speed multiplier during a template morph (SIM-FORM-032).

group_gap.description: Metres between regiments in a group formation (SIM-FORM-041).

skirmish_offset.description: Metres ranged regiments stand ahead of a battle line (SIM-FORM-041).

width_tolerance.description: Fraction of the requested width a group formation may miss by (SIM-FORM-042).

assign_search_radius.description: Metres around a soldier searched for free slots via the spatial grid (SIM-FORM-022).

swap_passes.description: In-rank swap passes after greedy assignment (SIM-FORM-022).

reform_angle.description: Degrees of anchor rotation that trigger a reform (SIM-FORM-020).

turn_in_place_angle.description: Degrees above which a halted regiment about-faces instead of wheeling (SIM-FORM-024).
